candidates.title: Ancient Egypt Unveiled: Treasures from Egyptian Museums
candidates.blurb: First major Egyptian antiquities show in Hong Kong draws from multiple Egyptian state collections, institutional diplomacy made tangible.

candidates.title: Treasures of Global Jewellery from The Metropolitan Museum of Art: The Body Transformed
candidates.blurb: The Met's global jewellery holdings positioned as anthropology, not luxury; cultural reading of bodily adornment across continents.

candidates.title: Blooming: The Art of Gardens in East and West
candidates.blurb: Comparative garden aesthetics between Chinese scholar gardens and European landscape tradition, timely given Hong Kong's spatial constraints.

candidates.title: Proudly from Canton: The Muwen Tang Collection of Cantonese and Export Art
candidates.blurb: Export porcelain and Cantonese visual culture read through private Hong Kong collection, Pearl River Delta identity politics via decorative arts.

candidates.title: A History of China in Silk: The Chris Hall Collection at the Hong Kong Palace Museum
candidates.blurb: Private Western collector's silk holdings propose alternative chronology of Chinese history, collecting as historiography.

candidates.title: Alicja Kwade: Waiting Pavilions
candidates.blurb: Site-specific pavilion in former prison yard, Kwade's sculptural meditation on cyclical time meets Hong Kong's layered histories.

candidates.title: Anne Imhof
candidates.blurb: Major solo of German performance-installation artist, JC Contemporary's bet on durational aesthetics in Asia's fastest city.

candidates.title: Fermata: Hong Kong in Venice
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong's Venice Biennale collateral exhibition returns home, musical pause as metaphor for the city's self-representation abroad.

candidates.title: Joyful Encounters: The Connoisseurship and Art of Wong Kwan Shut
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong collector-scholar as subject, local connoisseurship tradition positioned against mainland and Western models.

candidates.title: The Hong Jockey Club Series: The Forbidden City and the World: Cultural Encounters
candidates.blurb: Two-year installation examining Qing court's engagement with global trade and diplomacy, soft power archaeology.

candidates.title: Isaac Chong Wai: An Intimate Surrender
candidates.blurb: Hong Kong-born Berlin-based artist's performance and video work, endurance aesthetics meet post-handover identity discourse.

candidates.title: Wu Guanzhong Art Sponsorship Cross-disciplinary Series: Light Entry
candidates.blurb: Cross-disciplinary response to Wu Guanzhong's oeuvre, testing how institutional sponsorship shapes contemporary practice.
